name: Joshua
summary: Joshua, the son of Josedech, was the high priest when the people came back from captivity to Jerusalem. With Zerubbabel he rebuilt the altar and the house of the LORD, and in Zechariah's visions the LORD took away his filthy clothes and had crowns set on his head.

key_moments.title: Rebuilds the Altar of God
key_moments.description: When the people gathered in Jerusalem, Jeshua and the priests, with Zerubbabel, built an altar to Israel's God. Burnt offerings were made on it every morning and evening, as Moses' law said.

key_moments.title: Told to Be Strong and Work
key_moments.description: The LORD sent word through Haggai to Zerubbabel, Joshua the high priest and all the people. He told them to be strong and work, for He was with them.

key_moments.title: Given Clean Clothes in a Vision
key_moments.description: In a vision, Joshua stood in front of the angel of the LORD in filthy clothes, with Satan beside him to oppose him. The LORD rebuked Satan. Joshua's filthy clothes were taken away, his sin was taken from him, and a clean mitre was set on his head.

key_moments.title: Crowned as a Sign
key_moments.description: The LORD told Zechariah to make crowns of gold and silver and set them on Joshua's head. He spoke of a man called The BRANCH, who would build the LORD's temple and rule on his throne.
